newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Britain calls for Israel to take new measures.
newsitem.headline: Britain calls for Israel to take new measures.

text.p: Britain called on Israel on Friday to help defuse the crisis with the Palestinians by keeping a tunnel in Jerusalem closed and by starting the withdrawal of its forces from the West Bank town of Hebron.
British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind told reporters he would make the proposals at a meeting of the U.N. Security Council later on Friday.

More than 60 people died in three days of violence in the West Bank and Gaza, in protest at Israel's opening of a tourist tunnel adjacent to al-Aqsa and the Dome of the Rock mosques, Islam's third-holiest site.
Rifkind said the Israeli government should agree to keep the tunnel closed for now to reduce tensions.
"It was done (opened) very easily, it could be reversed very easily," he said.

He said Israel should show its wider support for the peace process by starting the long-delayed withdrawal of its forces from Hebron. "A commitment to start that process in the very near future would be a positive endorsement of the peace process," Rifkind said.
